Build one showcase entry

Source: R/module_showcase.R
INTERNAL_sci_showcase_entry.Rd

Looks the module's *InputsUI(), *OutputUI() and *Server() up by name, so an entry cannot name one module and wire another.

Usage

.sci_showcase_entry(
  module,
  label,
  tab_label,
  group,
  description,
  dataset,
  kind = c("df", "object"),
  defaults = list(),
  needs = character(0),
  preview = NULL,
  ui_data = NULL,
  app_datasets = NULL,
  figure_builder = FALSE
)

Arguments

module

The module's base name, e.g. "volcanoPlot".

label

The module's name in the Figure Builder's picker and on its gallery card.

tab_label

The shorter name on its gallery tab.

group

The gallery menu it sits under, one of .sci_gallery_groups.

description

One line for its gallery card and tab.

dataset

The .sci_example_catalogue() key its defaults are written for.

kind

"df" for a data frame fed through a filterable data table, or "object" for an object shown in a read-only preview.

defaults

The input defaults it opens on.

needs

Suggests packages the module needs beyond its dataset's.

preview

For "object" entries, a function returning the data frame the gallery previews.

ui_data

Optional function returning what *InputsUI() is given from the dataset, when that differs from what the server takes.

app_datasets

Further catalogue keys its *App() also offers.

figure_builder

Whether it is offered by the Figure Builder.

Value

A showcase entry.
